name: Medical Device Security Assessment
description: Covers security assessment of connected medical devices and their ecosystems with patient safety as the governing constraint. Includes IEC 81001-5-1 health software security lifecycle activities, AAMI TIR57 security risk management alongside ISO 14971 safety risk management, FDA premarket cybersecurity expectations (threat modelling, SBOM, security testing evidence), and patient-safety-aware penetration testing of devices, gateways and clinical interfaces. Generic IoT device testing technique belongs to ICSIOT-IOT-DEVICE.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to medical device security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the medical device threat landscape and regulatory context
evidence: Can explain why security flaws in medical devices are patient safety issues
Can name IEC 81001-5-1, AAMI TIR57, ISO 14971 and the FDA premarket cybersecurity guidance and their purpose
Aware of common device classes (infusion pumps, patient monitors, implantables, imaging) and their interfaces

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs medical device security testing tasks under supervision
evidence: Tests a lab medical device's network, wireless and physical interfaces using agreed safe procedures
Reviews a device SBOM against known vulnerabilities with guidance
Contributes to a security risk assessment by identifying threats per TIR57
Documents findings with their potential impact on clinical function

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses medical devices with patient-safety-aware methodology
evidence: Plans and executes a penetration test of a medical device and its ecosystem with safety stop conditions agreed with the manufacturer
Links security findings to hazardous situations and harms in the ISO 14971 risk file
Evaluates manufacturer evidence against IEC 81001-5-1 and FDA premarket cybersecurity expectations
Produces security test reports suitable for inclusion in a regulatory submission

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Leads complex medical device assessments; mentors others
evidence: Leads assessments of device families and connected systems (hubs, cloud, clinical integration)
Assesses wireless and proprietary telemetry of body-worn or implantable devices in shielded lab conditions
Reviews threat models and security architecture documentation for regulatory submissions
Mentors staff on safe medical device testing and regulatory reporting

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's medical device security practice; recognised authority
evidence: Established the lab's medical device security assessment methodology
Published research on medical device vulnerabilities or coordinated disclosure
Contributes to medical device security standards or regulatory guidance
Trains teams and manufacturers on medical device security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a lab medical device (e.g. infusion pump simulator or patient monitor) end to end under documented safety stop conditions, and map each finding to a hazardous situation
Review a medical device security test report for testing depth, traceability to the security and safety risk files, and suitability as premarket submission evidence
